# Tickwise

> Tickwise replaces the spinner words shown by Claude Code while it works with short, plain-text sponsor lines. Developers install a VS Code extension and earn per impression. Advertisers pay per 1,000 impressions to reach developers mid-task. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Pages
- [Home](https://tickwise.ashutoshswamy.in/): what Tickwise is, how it works, earnings estimator and FAQ
- [For developers](https://tickwise.ashutoshswamy.in/developers): how to earn with the extension
- [For advertisers](https://tickwise.ashutoshswamy.in/advertisers): how to run an ad
- [Terms of Service](https://tickwise.ashutoshswamy.in/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://tickwise.ashutoshswamy.in/privacy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://tickwise.ashutoshswamy.in/cookies)

## Key facts
- Ads are one line of plain text, 48 characters at most, with a required link.
- Developers earn 70% of what advertisers pay per impression. Payouts start at $10.
- The extension never reads prompts, code or files. It only notices that Claude Code session files changed.
- Works with Claude Code in the terminal and in the Claude Code VS Code extension.
